name: Comp Report
office_task: Every Monday, publish the multifamily comp report: availability, effective rents and the comp set, every figure linked to its source and read time.
systems_of_record: the property management system (rent roll and unit availability)
the comp survey the leasing team keeps
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the period's comp report per audience, each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the period's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, or an incomplete correction
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the period, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
